tei:div.tei:p: "!# : bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig mthong ba rang grol bzhugs so:

bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum gyi snying po 'o// sku gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: chos sku padma kun tu 'chang: longs sku thod phreng rigs mchog lnga: sprul sku ma nges 'gro 'dul phyir: mtshan dang bkod pa bsam yas bstan: de las dzaṃ gling o rgyan yul: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho rdzing du: padma ge sar sdong po la: so sor rtog pa'i rig mdangs hrī: ya mtshan cho 'phrul mtha' yas pas: brdzus skyes thog babs tshul nyid du: rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam par snang: de tshe ind+ra bhū ti yi: rigs kyi tshul bzung rgyal srid bskyangs: phan bde'i 'byor pa rgyas par byas: de nas brtul zhugs rol pa yis: dur khrod chen po'i gnas rnams su: gsang ba mchog gi spyod pa spyad: rlung sems las rung phyag rgya drug: rang bzhin sku gsum ston pa dang: paṇa grub dbang po brgya rtsa las: mdo rgyud thams cad thos shing sbyangs: nyams myong sgom pa'i drod rtags thon: rlung sems snang ba ro gcig pas: 'byung bzhir dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul dang: mā ra tī ka'i brag phug tu: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba thob: rgya gar yul gnas kun tu phyin: mu stegs rgol ngan mthu yis bcom: bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byas: yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: dpal chen yang dag bsgrubs pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs la phur bus btab: phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes brnyes: de nas gdong dmar bod yul 'dir: smon lam las 'brel btsan po yis: spyan drangs 'byung po gdug can kun: rdo rje khros pa'i shugs kyis btul: bsam yas sa gzhi yongs su bzung: mi dang mi min thams cad kun: rdzu 'phrul mthu yis bran du bkol: chos 'khor mig 'phrul lta bur grub: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: bkra shis rab gnas me tog 'thor: ngo mtshar ltas mchog mtha' yas pas: skal ldan tshogs rnams yi rangs gyur: bod la phan pa'i paṇa chen dang:

lo tsā mang po lung bstan nas: sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i tshogs: rgya cher bsgyur cing bshad sgrub btsugs: gsang ba bla na med pa yi: zab rgyas rgyud lung man ngag kun: snod ldan rnams la rgyas btab nas: so sos grub pa'i rtags mtshan phyung: khyad par mgrin bzang dbu rtse dang: mchims phu zab lung ti sgro sogs: bod kyi grub gnas mang po ru: mnga' bdag yab sras bai ro dang: mtsho rgyal la sogs rje 'bangs la: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: bka' dang dgongs 'dus chos kyi mdzod: mngon sum man ngag snying tig sogs: smin grol bshad pa'i char rgyun phab: grub pa mchog gi sa la bzhag: ma 'ongs don phyir gter du sbas: gter bdag srung mar gnyer byang gtad: yon mchod mdzad pa mthar phyin nas: rje gcig rgyal po dgung du gshegs: kho bo srin yul 'gro bar chas: g.yu ru khra 'brug gtsug lag tu: rje 'bangs rnams la ngal bso'i skyes: za hor rgyal po smin byas pa'i: bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i mdzod sgo phyes: sgrub pa'i dbang mchog bskur ba'i tshe: 'chi med mkha' 'gro mandā ras: de lta'i ngang tshul mngon shes te: skad cig bar snang glog 'khyugs bzhin: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor drung du lhags: phyag 'tshal gser gyi maṇḍal dang: snyoms 'jug bde ba'i mchod pa phul: thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba ni: e ma gu ru rin po che: bka' rnams 'dus pa'i snying po'i bcud: zab mo bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs: rgya cher gsungs pa'i don gyi mthil: bdag dang ma 'ongs gdul bya'i phyir: tshig nyung gnad 'dril nyams len bde: byin rlabs mngon sum 'beb pa yi: ngo mtshar gdams pa bstan du gsol: de ltar gus pas zhus pa'i ngor: sku gsum bstan pa gnyis ldan gyi: bla ma 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'di: snying gi zungs khrag lta bur bstan: rang nyams longs la drod rtags phyungs: dpe rgyud 'dra min gsum bris te: gcig ni ḍā ki mandā ras: stod phyogs bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams:

pu rṇa rdza ri mthon po'i shar: pha bong dga' 'khyil 'dra ba ru: smon lam thob la gter du sbos: rgyal po'i gdung rabs dgu yi mthar: mnga' bdag yab sras byin brlabs pa: badzra bha dra'i ming can dang: 'phrad nas 'gro don byed par 'gyur: gal te dus der ma thon na: rtsub 'gyur shin tu snyigs ma'i mthar: padma'i ming can rig 'dzin la: o rgyan bdag gis byin brlabs shing: mkha' 'gros zab mo'i brdas mtshon te: yi bzhin nor bu'i snying po dbye: skal ldan 'ga' zhig thar lam 'god: gcig ni padma brtsegs pa'i phug: khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs ka ru: phra men gzi yi sgrom bur sbos: rgyal sras rang gi skye bas rnyed: gcig ni khams kyi khyung phug tu: mtsho rgyal lcam gyis sbas byas na: lha sras lo tsā'i skye ba'i mtha': mchog gam las kyi ming dang 'phrad: mdor na da lta'i 'dus pa dang: ma 'ongs o rgyan rjes 'jug rnams: 'di la nyams len snying por dril: nges par bdag gis rjes su 'dzin: nyes spyod cha dang bcas pa spongs: lus ngag dge ba'i las la sbyor: mchog tu rang sems 'dul la brtson: zhal gdams snying po de kho na: nga la 'gro dang 'ong ba bral: srin yul gshegs pa ltar snang tsam: mos gus can la 'du 'bral med: gsol ba thob cig rjes 'jug rnams: 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs kun: o rgyan nga nyid dran pas chog: pad 'byung bdag gis bslu mi srid: the tshom spongs shig rjes 'jug rnams: nga la snying nas mos pa'i bu: tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag: padma 'od du skye bar nges: gdung shugs skyed cig rjes 'jug rnams: de tshe o rgyan bdag nyid kyi: dgyes zhal mjal zhing gdams pa ston: myur du byang chub skal ldan 'gyur: spro ba skyed cig rjes 'jug rnams: gzhan yang mchog dang thun mong gi: dngos grub phrin las thams cad kun: nga nyid sgrub pa kho nas 'byung: brtson pas sgrubs shig rjes 'jug rnams:

zhes bden pa'i tshig gis bka' bstsal pas rje 'bangs 'dus pa'i tshom bu thams cad la byin rlabs kyi byin phebs: gnam sa bla 'og 'dres pa lta bu'i mos gus kyi nyams shar: ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i gdung shugs dang bcas gu ru kho na yid la byed cing gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par gyur to: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: nges shes skyed pa lo rgyus kyi le'u ste dang pa'o: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs dad ldan skyes bu rnams: padma bdag nyid sgrub 'dod na: dbang blangs dam tshig srog ltar srungs: dben pa'i gnas su 'du 'dzi spongs: dkar phyogs lha klu gzhi bdag la: gtor ma sbyin zhing phrin las bcol: nag phyogs bgegs rigs srung mtshams bcad: sgrub khang phyags dar spos chus bran: sku gsung thugs rten byin can dgram: phyi nang mchod tshogs ci 'byor dang: khyad par bla ma'i gtor chen ni: bag dro brjid dang ldan pa bsham: bde ba'i stan la lus gnad bsrang: rlung ro dbyung zhing mos gus bskyed: bsam gtan snod du gyur pa na: sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang: dang po sngon 'gro'i bya ba la: skyabs su 'gro zhing byang sems bskyed: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis gsag: bgegs bskrad srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom: rgyun bshags bya zhing dam bca' bzung: ye shes gzi byin lhag par dbab: gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab: de ltar las rim dgu yin no: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed: gnas gsum byin brlabs ye shes bstim: bzhugs su gsol zhing rang dbang bskur: gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul: bzlas brjod bsnyen pas rtse gcig bsgrub: bstod pa bya zhing thugs dam bskul: de ltar las rim dgu la bslab: gsum pa mtha' rgyas rjes rim la: tshogs mchod 'bul zhing lhag ma bsngo: tha tshig bsgrags la brtan ma bskyang: las mjug rdo rje'i bro yis bsdu:

dus dang rgyun gyi dngos grub gsol: rtag mtha' sbyang zhing chad mtha' bsal: bsngo smon bya zhing shis pa brjod: de ltar dgu yis mthar dbyung ngo : bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: sgrub pa'i las rim mdor bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya:1$0000250 sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni: mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams: mngon sum bzhin du sad pa'i mdun: rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gro bya: 1$0000300na mo: bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang: sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi:1$0000250 gnyis pa sems bskyed gsal gdab ni:1$0000300 mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun don du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrubs nas ni: mchog dang thun mong phrin las kyis: gzhan don byed par sems bskyed do:1$0000250 gsum pa tshogs gnyis gsag pa ni: 1$0000300phyogs dus zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: bla ma sku gsum lha tshogs la: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod par 'bul: sdig sgrib nyes ltung mthol zhing bshags: 'khor 'das dge la rjes yi rang: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: phung po khams dang skye mched dang: gzung dang 'dzin pa las 'das pa'i: rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan: ma lus blo yis yongs bsdams nas: bla med chos dbyings snying por bsngo: yang dag ye shes mchog thob shog:1$0000250 bzhi pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: khrag 'thung 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na: dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren kun: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod rnams: song zhig lha min lha yang rung:

gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: 'bar ba khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: de ma thag tu bkas nas ni: bdun brgyud rigs kyang brlag par gyis: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra kro dha dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐:1$0000250 lnga pa srung mtshams bcad pa ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: padma ral gri'i gur gyis gtams: rab 'bar me yis kun tu khyab: khro bo khro mo sprin ltar gtibs: bskal pa'i rlung yang mi rgyu na: bar chad bgegs tshogs smos ci dgos: ye shes srung mtshams lhun gyis grub: oṃ badzra tsakra ratna padma tīkṣ+ṇa dzwa la raṃ ma hā kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐:1$0000250 drug pa rgyun bshags bya ba ni: 1$0000300ho: sems nyid rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag kyang: ma rig 'khrul pas sgro dang skur btab ste: nyon mongs dbang gyur las sgrib ci bsags pa: thams cad ro mnyam chos sku'i ngang du bshags: badzra sa ma ya bi shuddhe a a:1$0000250 bdun pa dam bca' bzung ba ni:1$0000300 oṃ: dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing: rig 'dzin bla ma bsgrub par dam bcas ltar: deng nas bzung ste bla med snying po'i bar: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mi gtong bzung: kā ya wa kā tsitta badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ:1$0000250 brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni: 1$0000300hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs sku bzhengs shig: 'khrul pa ka nas dag pa'i byin chen phob: lhun grub thig le chen po'i dbang mchog skur: bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i zhing khams nas: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku sku bzhengs shig: gzung 'dzin dbyings su zhi ba'i byin chen phob: ye shes rig rtsal rgyas pa'i dbang mchog skur: 'gro 'dul mi zad rgyan gyi zhing khams nas: bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs sku bzhengs shig:

snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa'i byin chen phob: mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi dbang mchog skur: hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs sras dang bcas: mkha' khyab chos sku'i dgongs pa lams se lam: rang byung longs sku'i ye shes ta la la: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul shigs se shig: rdo rje'i sku yi gar stabs khyugs se khyug: snying po sngags kyi dzap dbyangs 'u ru ru: bde chen thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: smin grol yon tan char 'bebs sha ra ra: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'bras bu spungs se spung: rtag rgyun rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: bdag cag mos pa'i gdung bas rgyud bskul na: gdul bya'i yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir sku bzhengs shig: byin chen byin phob rab 'byams rtsa ba gsum: dbang chen skur cig rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: dngos grub stsol cig yi dam zhi khro'i lha: bar chad bdud thul mkha' 'gro ging laṅka: myur ba nyid du gnas 'dir byin phob cig: rnal 'byor rgyud la bde chen ye shes spor: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog bde chen zhing du sgyur: phyi nang dam rdzas 'dod yon bcud du skyil: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dharmā kā ya dzñā na sa ma ya ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru saṃ bho ga kā ya dzñā na sa ma ya staṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru nirmā ṇa kā ya dzñā na sa ma ya ā be shā ya a ā: hrīṃ hrīṃ: pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:1$0000250 dgu pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: 1$0000300oṃ badzra a mṛta bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul kun: lāṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing: mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gzhir: oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad kyi: rang bzhin gzhal med khang chen po:

gdugs 'phen bla bre ba dan rgyan: rin chen nor bu'i dra bas spel: de dbus 'bru gsum yongs gyur las: phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon tshogs: mchod pa'i phyag rgya nam mkha'i mdzod: mkha' khyab sprin phung 'phro bar gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra nai bidyā āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ: mtshan ldan bhandha yangs pa'i nang: oṃ yig 'od du zhu ba las: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bcud du 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: ā: lcang lor bcas pa'i ka pā lar: āṃḥyig 'od du zhu ba las: khams gsum bsgral pa'i khrag gi mtsho: chags pa'i lbu phreng phyogs bcur g.yo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: hūm̐: rin chen padma bhañdza'i nang: hūm̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las: sha lnga bdud rtsi mnyam sbyar ba'i: gtor ma 'dod 'byung lhun por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de las gzhan yang ye shes sprin: kun tu bzang po'i rol mo las: mchod pa'i char rgyun mi zad pas: phyogs dus kun tu khyab par brdal: oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta: pra ra ṇi ta: saṃ pra ra ṇi ta: sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni: pra dzñā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we: badzra padma hṛ da ya: santoṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ:1$0000250 rol mor bcas pas byin dbab bo: 1$0000300bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i las rim bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la:1$0000250 dang po rten dang brten pa yi:

sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i las rim bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la: dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: gcan gzan pags pa'i gdan la sogs: rngam zhing brjid ldan stegs bu'i steng: sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa'i: ma da na dang bā la sogs: bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs rnams dang: mchod pa'i bye brag bkod mdzes bsham:1$0000250 me rlung chu yis bsang byas la: yi ge gsum gyis stong par sbyang: 1$0000300hūm̐: ye shes tshogs la mtshan rtog ma mchis kyang: dngos bshams rdzas kyi gzung 'dzin sbyang ba'i phyir: gnyis med rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pa'i rang gdangs rtsal: raṃ las lhag mthong me yis bag chags bsregs: yaṃ las rig rtsal rlung gis gnyis snang gtor: khaṃ las zhi gnas chu yis dag par bkrus: snod bcud stong gsal dbyings kyi thig ler 'khyil: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ:1$0000250 yi ge drug gis byin gyis brlab: 1$0000300slar yang ye shes drug gi rol pa'i rtsal: oṃ las 'od 'phros padma bhañdza'i snod: yangs shing rgya che stong gsum mnyam pa'i dbus: āḥlas 'od 'phros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: rigs lnga yab yum byang sems rgya mtshor bskyil: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros gzugs sgra dri ro reg: zag med 'dod yon phung po sprin ltar 'phro: ha hoḥhrīḥyi yi ge'i 'phro 'du las: kha dog dri ro nus pa rmad byung ba'i: bcud ldan zag med tshogs kyi longs spyod che: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa skong ba'i rdzas: 'phel 'grib med pa dbyings kyi rgyan du shar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī:1$0000250 de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: 1$0000300hūm̐ hrī: 'og min chos dbyings lhun rdzogs zhing khams nas: dkyil 'khor khyab bdag padma kun tu 'chang: rang snang ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas:

mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra dzñā na ā be sha ya a ā: hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: oṃ sarba ma hā pū dza mu dra sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: a: de bzhin nyid dbyings stong gsal chos kyi sku: kun snang ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sprin: zung 'jug sprul sku rgyu yi 'od zer gyis: gzung 'dzin dngos kun stong pa chen po'i ngang: yul snang thams cad 'og min gsang ba'i zhing: rdo rje'i srung 'khor dur khrod bkod pa'i dbus: rang byung lhun grub lus kyi gzhal med khang: ye shes yon tan rab rdzogs gzi byin 'bar: lte bar chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: yid chos rnam dag padma kun tu 'chang: bde ba'i bdag nyid nam mkha' dwangs ma'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum spyan gsum g.yo: thabs shes zung 'jug rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: gnyis med sbyor yum stong chen dbyings phyug ma: dkar gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin yab dang 'khyud: gnyis ka dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: ye shes 'od zer bsam yas 'phro 'du'i klong: rdo rje padma'i skyil krung rol pa yis: lhan skyes bde chen mchog gi gzi byin 'bar: dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag nyid chen por gsal: hūm̐: rigs kun khyab bdag chen po'i sku yi dbyings: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan grong khyer dbus: phung po 'byung ba rnam dag thod phreng lnga: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rdzogs: rnam shes rgyu ba'i dbang po'i thig le ru: tshogs brgyad gzung 'dzin gnas su dag pa'i rtsal: sprul pa'i skur snang mtshan mchog rnam pa brgyad: rigs kyi yum bcas gzi byin lam mer bzhugs: lnga ldan 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur: rtog tshogs rang grol thub dbang padma 'byung: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshom bu'i 'khor gyis bskor:

sku gsum bla ma bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs kyis: 'gro kun khyab bdag padma thod phreng dang: dbyer med byang chub go 'phang myur thob shog: hūm̐ hrī: bkra shis gang zhig 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes gzugs sku'i rnam rol cir yang ston: bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyis: byin rlabs dngos grub char 'beb bkra shis shog: de ltar zab mo'i rnal 'byor la: thun bzhir rtse gcig brtson par bya: khyad par lha sku'i gsal snang la: brten nas tha mal zhen pa sbyang: dben par lus bsrang rlung ro bsal: rang sems don gyi lhar shes shing: rig rtsal rdo rje lus kyi dal: chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bu la: yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig gtad: bying na gzengs bstod lta stangs gzir: rgod na lhod kyis klod de bzhag: bying rgod med par dwangs pa'i mtshor: gzugs brnyan shar ba ji bzhin du: lha dang sems nyid 'dres pa na: yun thung grangs mang mnyam par gzhag: skabs su nga rgyal drag tu brten: res 'ga' gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum: dbyer med don dang brda yi tshul: bden gnyis zung 'jug dag pa dran: dang por rtog pa long long g.yo: de nas sems 'dzin cung zad thob: bar du goms pas phal cher zin: brtan pas yul sems shin sbyangs skye: mthar phyin rlung sems lha skur shar: rnam smin rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: bskyed rim ci rigs goms pa yis: tshom bu tshogs dang bdud rtsi sman: 'chi med tshe dang las myur me: gzhan phan gnas kyi lung la brtson: dang po tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni: dben gnas skor khang rim gsum par: sgrub dang 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsags: gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po'i dus: ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yis: thog mar sa yi cho ga bya: phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshams bcad cing: bdag tu lta ba'i ru dra bsgral: khog pa dur khrod pho brang btab: sngags kyis yo byad byin gyis brlab: lhag pa'i lha la snyan gsan dbab:

bum par ye shes bdud rtsi bskyil: snod ldan slob ma lhag par gnas: maṇḍal thig dang tshon gyis bri: sgrub pa'i rdzas dang rgyan bkod cing: sgrub pa po rnams mnga' yang gsol: ye shes chen po'i gzi byin dbab: lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas: rang nyid nus dang ldan par bsnyen: rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs lha: bdag mdun dbyer med nye bsnyen dang: so sor dbye ba'i sgrub pa yis: bzlas brjod chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bya: tshogs kyi 'khor lo dus drug bskor: bar chad nyu le tshar thag bcad: byin chen dbab cing nyams chag bskang: de ltar rtse gcig brtson pa las: dngos grub mchog gi rtags byung na: srod la dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral: nam gung snyoms 'jug bde chen bskyed: tho rangs mthar phyin sgrub pa ches: las dang ye shes dngos grub blang: slob ma smin byed dbang yang bskur: tshogs kyi dga' ston rgyas par bya: dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing mtshams yang dgrol: rnam dag smon lam rgya cher gdab: bkra shis me tog char du bsnyil: de ltar bsgrubs pa'i rnal 'byor pa: dngos grub thob pa lta ci smos: 'brel tshad bde chen ngang du grol: snod bcud bkra shis byin chen 'gyur: sa ma ya: bdud rtsi mchog gi sbyor ba ni: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang brgyud pa yi: khams lnga bcud kyi snying po ste: sha chen lnga yis nus pa bskyed: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bas: dngos grub rab 'byams 'grub par 'gyur: de phyir rdzas rnams tshogs pa na: 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis dri ma bsal: khrol bu thod phreng rigs lngas sbyangs: btags btsags sbol la phab kyis bran: rang byung bhandha'i snod du bskyil: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskyed cing bzlas: khyad par bdud rtsi bsdu ba dang: dbab dang bskyil ba'i dmigs pa bcas: oṃ ma hā gu ru badzra a mṛta hūm̐ hrī ṭhā: oṃ ma hā gu ru badzra a mṛta ā we sha ya a ā: oṃ ma hā gu ru badzra a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ hūm̐:

rim par bzlas pas nus pa brtan: skabs su sman srung spyan drangs shing: rtog pa bsal nas las la bskul: sgrub pa chen pos gzhung bsrangs la: bdun phrag gcig gam gsum du brtson: ya mtshan gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra: bde rlung sems la dbang thob 'gyur: dri dang ro dang rgya cher 'phel: de tshe dngos grub tshul bzhin blang: snod ldan dbang gis rjes su bzung: gang zhig dri tsam tshor bas kyang: tshe ring nad med nyams chag skong: yid 'phrog dpal chen mthu rtsal ldan: mchog gi rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: 'chi med tshe yi cho ga ni: bkra shis sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor mtshan rdzogs tshul bzhin bzhengs: khyad par snying po'i 'brang rgyas ni: tshe yi rig pa'i srog ldan pa: nyi zla'i rgyan gyis spras pa dang: dngos grub thabs shes rdzas kyang bsham: las kyi gzhung bsrang bzlas pa'i dus: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i steng: rig pa mi 'gyur ye shes tshe dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i tshe bum bsnams: rang 'od yum 'khyud longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: padma rā ga'i 'od zer bye ba 'gyed: de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: hrīḥmathar tshe yi rig pas bskor ba las: lha mo mgyogs ma nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros: 'khor 'das thams cad mer mer shig shig g.yos: bla tshe 'phrog pa'i 'byung po zil gyis mnan: snod bcud dwangs ma rang dbang med par 'phrog: rtsa gsum rab 'byams bde chen thugs rgyud bskul: 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par char ltar babs: bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pa yis: bla srog sor chud 'byung lnga'i nus stobs 'phel: rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dang lang tsho 'bar: ye shes mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma ā yurdzñā na sarba siddhi hūm̐: skabs su tshe 'gugs thugs dam bskul: hūm̐ hrī: bzhengs shig bla ma bde gshegs rab 'byams tshogs:

chos kyi dbyings las ye shes gzi byin skyed: sprul pa'i pho nya mgyogs ma las la bskul: thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu spros: srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis: brkus dang 'phrog dang bzhams pa'i tshe khug cig: phyi nang ban bon sngags kyi sbyor ba yis: byad dang gtad du bcug pa'i tshe khug cig: brtan g.yo'i snod bcud 'byung ba rnam pa lnga'i: dwangs ma stobs su gyur pa'i tshe khug cig: phyogs bcu'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes tshe khug cig: tshe khug g.yang skyobs srog gi ka ba tshugs: 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub stsol: tshe mda' g.yab cing gdung shugs bskyed: rdo rje'i gsang sngags 'bru bco brgyad: 'bum phrag gsum du bzlas pa yis: bar chad sel zhing tshe bsod 'phel: rtags mthong dbang dang dngos grub blang: tshe dang ye shes rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: las rnams myur du sgrub byed pa: myur lam me yi cho ga ni: las dang mthun pa'i chas gos dang: 'dug stangs lta phyogs ma nor bas: rdzas dang las dkyil 'du byas la: rung ba'i bud shing me sbar brlab: me lha dgug cing mchod byas la: 'bar ba'i klong du dkyil 'khor bskyed: dam tshig ye shes ldan byas te: mchod cing bstod de byon skyems dang: las dang mthun pa'i rdzas rnams 'bul: oṃ agna ye swā hā: oṃ dzñā na brikṣā ya swā hā: oṃ sarba bighnān pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: bhrūm̐ sarba ā yur puṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ: hrīḥsarba lo ka dzñā na pā shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐ sarba bighnān shā trūn mā ra ya phaṭa: rtsa ba'i sngags la las kyi gzer: btags nas khyad par rdzas dang sbyar: ji ltar rigs pa phul byas te: las mthun 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par bsam: rjes su ye shes 'jig rten gyi: me lhar gtang rag 'bul ba dang:

dngos grub gsol zhing nongs pa bshags: ye shes gshegs gsol dam tshig pa: 'bar ba'i 'od kyi rnam par bsam: bsngo smon bkra shis glu blangs pas: gang brtsam las kun myur du 'grub: rgyun gyi tshogs gsog me mchod ni: bzang shing me sbar skad cig gis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal btab nas: phye mar 'bru sman dri dang spos: ji ltar rigs pa me la bsreg: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi a mṛta pū dza ho: sarba karma ku ru hūm̐: brgya rtsa brgyad sogs ci 'byor 'bul: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes me dang dbyer med rig pa'i lha: zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bras bu bstsal du gsol: sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: rjes ni mi dmigs ngang la bzhag: gang yang lha rnams zhal gyi sgo: me dang gnyis su med pa nyid: mnyes pas sdig sgrib kun sreg cing: gang 'dod las kun myur du 'grub: sa ma ya: nyam thag bar do'i yid can rnams: gnas kyi lung gis dbugs dbyung phyir: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bsham: phyi nang mchod tshogs dpung bskyed la: phrin las gzhung bsrang bzlas brjod bya: khyad par las kyi bum pa ru: padma kun tu 'chang ba nyid: gu ru drug gis bskor bar gsal: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: bum chu sgrib sbyong nus ldan bsam: gtso 'khor rig pa sham bcas bzla: mchod cing bstod la 'od du bzhu: dam bshags dam skong cho ga ni: rgyas par bya zhing tshogs 'khor bskor: tshe 'das ro 'am rus pa 'am: ming byang rigs drug dal du bkod: gzugs brnyan bskyed cing rnam shes dgug: bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang byas la: dmyal ba'i gnas nas drang ba'i phyir: gtor ma byin la lan chags sbyang: hūm̐ hrī: 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma'i longs spyod 'di: tshe 'das zhe sdang rang gzugs las byung ba'i: dmyal ba'i lan chags bu lon sbyong phyir bsngo:

tsha grang sdug bsngal kun las grol gyur cig: sarba pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa ba liṃ ta pra tītstsha ho: byang chub sems kyi chu yis bkru: hūm̐ hrī: bkra shis bum pa rang byung gzhal med khang: lha dang gnyis med ye shes rgyun gyis gtams: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la khrus bgyis pas: zhe sdang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dag par shog: sngags dang yi ge brgya pas brab: khyad par bye ma yungs kar brdeg: hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs rje'i snang ba yis: gu ru rnam par gnon pa'i thugs rgyud bskul: ye shes 'od zer me lce lta bu yis: tshe 'das dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras bsregs shing sbyangs: sngags dang bcas te thun gyis brab: gu ru'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: rkang mthil gnyis kyi duḥyig bsregs: dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras dag par bsam: dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs 'gror dmigs: na mo: sku gsum bla ma bde gshegs dkyil 'khor dang: 'gro 'dul gu ru rnam par gnon pa la: tshe 'das phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su mchi: tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas nas drang du gsol: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍa la na mā mi: lha tshogs thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: rnam par gnon pa'i thugs rgyud bskul: sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa 'phros: me long ye shes dbang bskur bsam: hūm̐ hrī: chos sku skye med ngang las longs spyod rdzogs: 'gro 'dul sprul sku rnam par gnon pa yis: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs zhe sdang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras sbyangs: rdo rje'i rigs kyi zhing la dbang bsgyur nas: me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon gyur shog: sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dmigs rten yi dwags dal du drang: rdo rjes phyir lam bcad nas kyang: hūm̐ hrī: sa 'di man chad tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas: sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bzod dka' ya re nga: nges 'byung chen pos dkyil 'khor drung du snyogs: phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang thob par shog:

sarba na ra ka duḥkha tstshinda tstshinda hūm̐ phaṭa: de ltar dmyal ba'i gnas nas drangs: phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas btab nas: yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin: lha dang mi yi gnas rigs las: lha sngags kha bsgyur rim bzhin drangs: rig 'dzin gral du 'khod par bsam: dmigs rten dkyil 'khor drung du bzhag: phyag 'tshal skyabs sems sdom pa sbyin: lhar bskyed ye shes dbab cing brtan: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur rnams: rgyas par bya 'am mdor bsdu na: oṃ: bkra shis mi 'gyur dbyings kyi bum pa na: rig pa rang snang ye shes lha yi tshogs: 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: snang stong sku yi ye shes 'grub par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: ā: bde chen bhandhar stong nyid bcud du 'khyil: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsung dang gnyis su med: rtsa rlung byang chub sems la dbang bskur bas: grags stong gsung gi ye shes 'grub par shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: hūm̐: dbyings kyi ngo bo dag pa shel lta bu: ye shes rigs lnga 'ja' tshon bzhin du 'phro: zung 'jug don gyi dgongs pas dbang bskur bas: rig stong thugs kyi ye shes 'grub par shog: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje gsum ldan ye shes kyis: rgyal tshab sa la lhun grub bsam: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod: hūm̐ hrī: nyon cig rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob khyod: 'khor ba'i gnas rigs kun la ma chags par: rlung sems snying po dwangs ma yid kyi lus: lha sngags ye shes phyag rgya'i dam tshig gis: lam lnga sa bcu skad cig nyid la bgrod: dbugs chen 'byin pa rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing: rang byung 'od gsal 'bar ba'i zhing khams su: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dbyer med par: mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa mngon gyur shog: ces brjod phaṭa kyis rnam shes gshegs: snyigs ma ye shes me yis bsreg: sku gdung sātstsha gdab par bya: rnam dag bsngo smon rgya cher brjod:

dkyil 'khor rjes chog tshul bzhin bsgrub: 'dis ni ngan 'gror 'gro ba yi: mtshams med las byas sems can kyang: thabs dang snying rje chen po'i mthus: mtho ris gnas su dbugs 'byin na: lam la gnas pa'i gang zag kun: thar pa thob pa smos ci dgos: de phyir sngags shes snying rje can: gzhan phan 'dod pas rab tu bsgrub: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: rnal 'byor bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes 'di'i mjug phab ma grub bo// maṅga laṃ// //
